description: Ask BanditDB which arm to pick for a given context. Optional exclude_arms / eligible_arms narrow the choice for this request only. Returns the arm and an interaction_id to save.

context.description: Context for the decision: an object of features or an array of values.

eligible_arms.description: Array of string values for this parameter (optional).

exclude_arms.description: Array of string values for this parameter (optional).

name: get_intuition
